An R package to query ANSIS and massage the responses into various useful formats.

The [Australian National Soil Information System](https://ansis.net/) (ANSIS) brings together a range of publicly available soil profile data sets from across Australia. It delivers data in the form of a standardised JSON Schema preserving complex relationships within the data. This JSON data can be daunting to untangle.

ANSR does all the hard work of querying ANSIS and parsing the JSON response data into falt csv file formats.

## Install ANSR

The ANSR package is hosted in a GitHub repo at - <https://github.com/RossDSearle/ANSR>

The easiest way to install it is by using the R "pak" package

``` r
devtools::install(build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

Once the ANSR package is installed you load it using -

``` r
library(ANSR)
```

The ANSR package utilises the ANSIS web API in the background to do all the querying of the ANSIS datastore.

[The API docs can be viewed using the view api docs function]{style="color: red;"}
